title: Kimi K3 launches breakthrough AI beating Claude in efficiency and #kimiK3 #AIbreakthrough #openAI
description: Kimi K3, developed by Moonshot AI, emerged as the largest open-source AI model with 2.8 trillion parameters, rivaling established models like Claude and GPT. It powers innovative projects including a fully explorable 3D open world and physics-simulated AI water, showcasing advanced capabilities in gaming and motion graphics. Its competitive pricing at $3 per million tokens undercuts expensive models like Fable 5, making high-performance AI more accessible for development and experimentation. While not dominating all benchmarks, Kimi K3’s rapid progress signals significant disruption potential in the AI market, particularly as China accelerates its AI advancements. This breakthrough highlights a shift towards open-source, cost-efficient AI models capable of complex simulations and creative applications, reshaping the competitive landscape and fostering greater innovation worldwide. #KimiK3 #MoonshotAI #OpenSourceAI #TrillionParameterModel #ChineseAI #ClaudeAI #GPT5 #AIinnovation #ArtificialIntelligence #3DOpenWorld #MotionGraphicsAI #AIGaming #AIwaterPhysics #SiliconValley #AIcompetition
